About Retatrutide

Retatrutide is a synthetic peptide of 39 amino acids, with a 20-carbon fatty diacid attached to lysine 17 through a short linker.1 Eli Lilly and Company discovered and developed it under the code LY3437943.23 In laboratory cell tests, the single molecule activated three receptors: GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon.2 Its activity was balanced at the glucagon and GLP-1 receptors and higher at the GIP receptor.2

Lilly's human trials, in adults with obesity, overweight or type 2 diabetes, have reached phase 3.83 For a plain-language guide to that evidence and its legal status, read What is Retatrutide?. This vial sits in Weight Loss Peptides with the other GLP-1 research vials, and the full range is under research peptides.

Research highlights

  • Mouse studies: in obese mice, retatrutide lowered body weight and improved blood sugar control.2 Glucagon receptor activity added a rise in energy expenditure.2
  • Phase 1b, 72 adults with type 2 diabetes: the half-life was about 6 days.9 Over 12 weeks, HbA1c fell up to 1.6 percentage points more than with placebo.9
  • Phase 2, 338 adults with obesity or overweight: average weight fell 8.7% to 24.2% by dose over 48 weeks, versus 2.1% on placebo.10
  • Phase 2a substudy, 98 adults with fatty liver disease: liver fat fell 82.4% at the top dose over 24 weeks, versus a 0.3% rise on placebo.11
  • Phase 3 TRIUMPH-1, 2,339 adults with obesity and without diabetes: average weight fell 17.6% to 25.0% by dose over 80 weeks, versus 3.9% on placebo.12
  • Phase 3 TRANSCEND-T2D-1, 537 adults with type 2 diabetes: HbA1c fell 1.69 to 1.94 percentage points over 40 weeks, versus 0.81 on placebo.13
  • Safety in trials: nausea, diarrhea and other digestive events were the most common adverse events, and they rose with dose.1014 See Retatrutide side effects.

Regulatory status

As of October 2026, no regulator has approved retatrutide, and Lilly calls it a phase 3 investigational molecule.3 FDA states that retatrutide cannot be used in compounding under federal law, is not a component of any FDA-approved drug and has not been found safe and effective for any condition.15

FDA has sent warning letters to online sellers of research-labeled retatrutide, including letters in December 2024 and March 2026.161718 In each letter, FDA said evidence from the seller's own website showed the products were meant as drugs for people, despite research-use labels, which made them unapproved new drugs.161718 FDA says such products have been sold directly to consumers with dosing instructions, and it urges consumers not to buy them because they are of unknown quality and may be harmful.15

Lilly plans to submit retatrutide for US review in the first quarter of 2027, and says neither approval nor that timeline is guaranteed.193 In sport, WADA's 2026 Prohibited List does not name retatrutide.20 Its class S0 bans at all times any substance not covered elsewhere on the List that has no current approval for human therapeutic use, such as drugs in clinical development.20 D2C Peptides sells this vial for laboratory research only.

Handling and storage

Labs that buy retatrutide online receive freeze-dried powder, which is reconstituted with a diluent before bench work.4 No approved label gives mixing directions.15 How to reconstitute a peptide vial sets out the lab steps and sterile technique. The reconstitution calculator handles the concentration math. It is one division: 10 mg in 2 mL of diluent gives 5 mg per mL.

Supplies used for this lab work:

  • Bacteriostatic water as the diluent
  • 3 mL Luer-Lok syringes and 18G 1-inch needles to draw and transfer diluent
  • Insulin syringes for measuring small volumes
  • Alcohol swabs for wiping vial stoppers

Frequently asked questions

Can I buy retatrutide peptide in the USA?

D2C Peptides sells retatrutide as a research vial, labeled for research use only and shipped across the United States. It is not an approved medicine: no regulator has approved it. Lilly, its developer, says it cannot legally be sold or marketed for human use, and that products claiming to be retatrutide offered for sale to consumers are unlawful.3 The research use policy sets the terms.

Which strengths are available, and where do orders ship from?

The vial comes in 10 mg, 30 mg strengths of the same freeze-dried compound; only the amount per vial differs.4 Orders ship from the USA and Canada to addresses across the United States. The shipping page has delivery details, and the returns page has return terms. Larger lab orders go through a wholesale account.

How should the vial be stored when it arrives?

The supplier's directions conflict.4 Its specification table lists a shelf life of 36 months at -20°C and 30 days at 2 to 8°C, but its description says the sealed vial can stay at room temperature until mixing, then go in a refrigerator at 2 to 8°C once mixed.4 Peptide makers' general guidance is to store freeze-dried peptides at -20°C, away from bright light.22 How to store peptides covers general storage practice.

Is there a certificate of analysis for this retatrutide?

Certificates of analysis, where available, are listed on Lab results and certificates of analysis; match any certificate to your vial's lot. This matters for retatrutide: a 2026 study of three products sold in Australia as retatrutide 10 mg measured 5.13 mg, 16.5 mg and 19.0 mg, or 51% to 190% of the label.21
